english.title: Supply of regulated poison by person other than a pharmacist
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) unlawfully supplied a regulated poison, namely **(..SPECIFY POISON..), to a member of the general public
english.legislation: Contrary to sections3B(1) and 8(1)of the Poisons Act 1972.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
supplied a regulated poison

other than in circumstances described in subsection (2)

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 2(5) of the Poisons Act 1972 gives the meaning of a regulated poison.
(ii) The circumstances in section 3B(2) in which this offence would not be committed are the person is lawfully conducting a retail pharmacy business, the supply is made on premises that are a registered pharmacy; and the supply is made by or under the supervision of a pharmacist.
(iii) A person does not commit an offence under subsection (1) if the requirements of that subsection do not apply to the person's case by virtue of regulations made under section 9B (section 3B(5)).
(iv) See section section 7A which gives the defence of proof of lack of knowledge.
